text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Just as I thought, the Umamusume running in the Arima Kinen
are all totally amazing."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
“Still, they chose me.
—This time, I have to repay those feelings.”

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“――Congratulations!”
“Great job, everyoneee!!”
“That was the best race ever!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The pouring cheers were profoundly warm.
While honoring the winner...
they also showed appreciation for every single Umamusume who made this year so exciting.
choice_data_list: (So this is the air of the Grand Prix—)

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Buena-chan, great job this past year...!"
"That was such an incredible run~!"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"‘Hang in there, Buena Vista-san!!’
‘—You are the heroine of the next era--!!’"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Unwavering expectations. Their voices...
I can't take this for granted. ...I have to answer them.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Next year, for sure—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I will show you a magnificent view!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By the time Buena Vista returned,
she had already shifted her mindset
and was calmly looking ahead.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I was grateful for their unwavering cheers.
So I can't betray their trust ever again."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Next time,
I'll definitely live up to your expectations!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Journey-san...!
...Thank you for your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, thank you for your hard work as well.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: A defeat is still a defeat... so I'm not sure if saying something like this is right, but—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Your running was... even more wonderful
than I had anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Today brings an end to this year...
while also foretelling the next.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
In other words... even in defeat, you command high expectations.
You are the true star of next year.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However, the racing world changes in the blink of an eye.
Just like when you appeared—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—New storms are constantly brewing.
Before you get swept up in them...
I hope you reach a magnificent view.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Journey-san...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"You're encouraging me, aren't you?
Thank you very much! However—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Even if I get swallowed up by a storm, I won't care!
Because I have—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Because I have people who will pull me up.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...I suppose that was unsolicited encouragement.
Well, as long as I'm meddling, here's one more thing—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Please watch your step in the mud.
...Well then, good work today."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"The mud at our feet...
Could they be referring to the race?"
choice_data_list: I don't know. But... I should remember that.
I don't know. But... I'll remember that.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: “You're right. Knowing Journey-san, it's definitely meaningful advice.”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
So the Classic Year is coming to an end, huh.
choice_data_list: We've got to set our goals for next year, too.
We need to decide on our goals for next year, too.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Assuming the ultimate goal
is the Japan Cup...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I want to keep living up to their expectations all the way there.
Because reaching that point with everyone's feelings behind me is what matters most."
choice_data_list: In that case, the Victoria Mile would be first, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Many Senior-class Umamusume from the Tiara route compete in the Victoria Mile. It's the race that crowns the strongest Tiara runner over the mile.
choice_data_list: Because everyone wants to see you looking like the Queen you are.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I see. Gotta show everyone how cool we can be!
...I wonder if Desire-chan is running too?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
If it's with Desire-chan,
everyone will have even higher hopes for us.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I hope we can clash again.
Yeah, it'd be great if you two could clash again.

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff A
text_block_list.text: ...Buena Vista-san, we are ready for your interview...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Please wait just a little longer!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Does my hair and everything... look okay?
choice_data_list: Maybe it's sticking up a bit?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
I wonder if I can fix it right away...
choice_data_list: Well, it's cute, so I think it's fine.
Well, it's cute, so why not?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Oof.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Don't just go saying things like that
so casually, okay?

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
...Buena Vista-san!
...What about next year?...
...A message for your fans, please!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your questions, everyone.
I'll answer them one by one!
choice_data_list: (Looks like she's going to be super popular again next year...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista successfully ran the Arima Kinen.
Thanks in part to the race's prestige,
her name became even more widely recognized by the public.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――Even more than I had anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Townsperson A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, did you see the recent Arima Kinen!?
There was this super cute girl...!

text_block_list.name: Townsperson B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I saw it~!
It was Buena Vista-chan, right?

text_block_list.name: Townsperson B
text_block_list.text:
That went super viral on UmaTok, right?
The one where you running with all your might was so touching it brought people to tears!

text_block_list.name: Townsperson A
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! That made me look up a bunch
of past footage too, and... she's seriously so cute, right?

text_block_list.name: Townsperson A
text_block_list.text:
Plus, she's super strong!
I might just have become a fan~!

text_block_list.name: Townsperson B
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Let's go cheer for her next time!
—I can't wait to see Buena-chan next year~!
